data.name: AccountNotFound
data.value: This account could not be found.

data.name: ZoneNotFound
data.value: This DNS zone could not be found.

data.name: RecordNotFound
data.value: This DNS record could not be found.

data.name: ZoneNameInvalid
data.value: A zone name must be a domain name of at least two labels, such as example.com.

data.name: ZoneNameTaken
data.value: A zone with this name already exists.

data.name: ZoneNameReserved
data.value: This name is used by the panel itself and cannot be a zone.

data.name: ZoneOverlapsForeignZone
data.value: This name overlaps a zone that belongs to another account.

data.name: ZoneApexNotClaimed
data.value: This domain is not served by any of your sites. Add it to a site first.

data.name: ZoneLimitReached
data.value: Your plan does not allow more DNS zones.

data.name: ZoneLimitReachedConcurrently
data.value: Another zone took the last place your plan allows. Nothing was created.

data.name: ZoneChangedMeanwhile
data.value: The zone was changed by someone else at the same time. Reload it and try again.

data.name: DnsNotEnabled
data.value: The name server is not switched on for this server.

data.name: DnsSettingsIncomplete
data.value: The name servers and the hostmaster mailbox must be set before the name server can be switched on.

data.name: ZoneRecordLimitReached
data.value: This zone already holds the most records the server allows.

data.name: RecordNameInvalid
data.value: The record name is not valid. Use @ for the zone itself, or letters, digits, hyphens and underscores in labels of up to 63 characters.

data.name: RecordTtlOutOfRange
data.value: The time to live must be between 60 seconds and one week.

data.name: RecordValueInvalid
data.value: The value is not valid for this record type.

data.name: RecordPriorityOutOfRange
data.value: The priority must be a whole number from 0 to 65535, and only MX and SRV records have one.

data.name: RecordWeightOutOfRange
data.value: The weight must be a whole number from 0 to 65535, and only SRV records have one.

data.name: RecordPortOutOfRange
data.value: The port must be a whole number from 0 to 65535, and only SRV records have one.

data.name: RecordFlagsInvalid
data.value: The flags must be 0 or 128, and only CAA records have them.

data.name: RecordTagInvalid
data.value: The tag must be issue, issuewild or iodef, and only CAA records have one.

data.name: RecordCnameBesideOtherData
data.value: A CNAME cannot share a name with other records.

data.name: RecordOtherDataBesideCname
data.value: This name is already an alias (CNAME), so it cannot hold other records.

data.name: RecordCnameAtApex
data.value: The zone itself cannot be a CNAME.

data.name: RecordNsAtApex
data.value: The name servers of the zone itself are managed by the panel and cannot be edited.

data.name: RecordDuplicate
data.value: The zone already holds this exact record.

data.name: RecordNotEditable
data.value: This record is managed by the panel and cannot be edited here.

data.name: DnsNameserverInvalid
data.value: A name server must be a host name such as ns1.example.com.

data.name: DnsHostmasterInvalid
data.value: The hostmaster mailbox must be written with dots, such as hostmaster.example.com for hostmaster@example.com.

data.name: DnsAddressInvalid
data.value: The address is not a valid IP address of the expected kind.

data.name: DnsDefaultTtlOutOfRange
data.value: The default time to live must be between 60 seconds and one week.
